input.standard: ASTM E741 (tracer gas concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the served volume V_lab (m3) of the Lab as V = Qe * tau, from the CO2 rise at reduced scrubber speed and the decay at full speed, occupants as the source.

monitoring.reason: The two occupants of the Lab breathe the air whose CO2 the test raises; they are the CO2 source and are held in the Lab throughout.

steps.why: Rise: reduce the scrubber to the floor speed so the Lab CO2 climbs towards a higher equilibrium (occupants 2 x 0.38 L/min). Hatch held closed.
Decay: full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min), record the fall towards the full-speed equilibrium; about one tau for a first guess V = 30 m3 (tau = 30 min). Hatch held closed, same as step 1.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
FE-1 or FE-2 out of the 45-120 bpm band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the Lab

expected.start: Lab CO2 about 2000 ppm at the start (measured), at least 200 ppm under the 3000 ppm limit.
expected.step1: CO2 rises slowly towards an equilibrium G/Qe with G = 2 x 0.38 = 0.76 L/min and Qe = 0.3 m3/min (about 2500 ppm above a zero baseline); for V=30 m3 tau = 100 min at 30 percent, so only about +100 to +150 ppm in 25 min, peak well under 3000 ppm. A rise of less than sensor noise would show the flow is not proportional to speed or V is much larger than 30 m3.
expected.step2: After a lag of about 3.3 min (scrubber lag) CO2 decays towards C_eq = G/Qe (about 760 ppm above baseline for Qe = 1 m3/min) with tau = V/Qe; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau) on data after 10 min of each step; V_lab = Qe*tau, first guess 30 m3 (default, range 10-200). Hab-B CO2 should stay flat if the closed hatch exchanges little air; a drift in Hab-B CO2 towards the Lab's would show exchange (design 3 m3/min with hatch closed) and bias V high.
expected.reject: Non-exponential curve, fitted tau inconsistent between the two steps, a person entering/leaving the Lab, or a command refused: discard the curve.

hypotheses: The Lab is one well-mixed zone.

The hatch is held closed for the whole test; the exchange through the closed hatch with Hab-B (design 3 m3/min per station-topology) is not measured and not assumed zero: it is recorded through Hab-B CO2 and left to be decided otherwise.
The occupants' number (2) and activity (awake, 0.38 L/min each) stay constant; no one enters or leaves.
Effective flow scales linearly with speed: Qe = 1 m3/min at 100 percent (datasheet), 0.3 m3/min at 30 percent; the scrubber lag of 3.33 min is excluded from the fit.
Each phase is shorter than the ideal of several tau because the total is capped at 60 minutes; the rise at 30 percent covers only a fraction of its tau, so tau is fitted mainly on the decay.
Records: Lab and Hab-B CO2 every minute, scrubber speed commands and acceptance.
